book.name: Mbouŋ to Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content: Maaron ineep toman ghiit ve iŋginŋgin ghiit

content.text: Matag izala pa lolooz naghaze naghita:
Yoova moghon to pale nagham ulaaŋ ila toni.
Ye to ighur sambam ve taan.
Ye pale mata payom. Irau ipul ghom aghem kirikia ve utap maau. Ŋginiiŋ tiom ipamaat irau sawa isob.
Onoon kat, ŋginiiŋ to iit Israela, ighaze mata ighengheen, nene irau igheen maau.
Yoova mata payom ve iŋgin ghom, leso uneep pooi.
Ye ineep ila digem, ve inim yavyaav payom pa ipoon ghom pa ndag. Mbo 91:1+
Tovenen ighaze ndag, ndag irau ighaaz katin ghom maau.
Ve mboŋ, kaiyo irau iwaghamun ghom maau.
Yoova pale mata payom, ve ipoon ghom pa mbeb samsamia to naol.
Ye tau pale iŋgin ghom uneep pooi. Mbo 91:9+
Ye pale mata pa laghooŋ tiom ve nepooŋ tiom. Tovenen sawa to upul ruum ve uvot ula, le sawa to ulooŋ umuul unum, ye pale ineep toman ghom, ve iŋgin ghom uneep pooi.
To aazne, ve itaghoni taghoni gha ila.
